principles.name: Section toolbar and title
principles.requirement: Every panel section starts with a toolbar containing a section title (with SVG icon), optional helper text, and a view-switch when multiple presentation modes exist.

principles.name: Multi-mode presentation
principles.requirement: Data sections support switching presentation modes (cards, table, list, matrix, import, …) without a full page reload.

principles.name: Create/import always last
principles.requirement: In a view-switch, the create/import/add/register control MUST be the last control. Do not duplicate a leading '+' character when an SVG plus icon is already present.

principles.name: Newest first
principles.requirement: Creating a resource prepends it to the collection [new, ...prev].

principles.name: Lazy loading
principles.requirement: Production collections use a unified infinite-scroll (or equivalent) footer to load further pages.

principles.name: URL state sync
principles.requirement: Panel state is shareable via history.replaceState without full reload. Canonical params: tab, view, nested selection ids (project/host/org/…), registry, tag, filter.

principles.name: Org → project → artifacts
principles.requirement: When projects exist, present org filter, project list, then project detail with tickets/artifacts. IA order preference: system chat → account → integrations → … → projects → organization registers.

principles.name: Connector registry filters
principles.requirement: Connector catalogs support tags, text filter, mode switch (e.g. MCP/A2A), and register-as-last view-switch mode. New entries prepend.

principles.name: System chat surface
principles.requirement: When a system chat surface exists (e.g. OpenWebUI), durable URL configuration is account/hosting + server-side injection (env / PHP window global). Browser-only localStorage is optional override, never the sole persistence. Unavailable services fail gracefully.

principles.name: Inline SVG icons
principles.requirement: Navigation and action icons use inline SVG components. Unicode/emoji as control icons are forbidden.

required_assertions: URL reflects tab and view without reload
Infinite-scroll footer present on production collections
